_comment: Endpoints for claude-superset-api (oci-apps, WG-only). Source of truth: cloud build.json ports (ip 10.0.0.6). Reachable from this phone over the WireGuard mesh.
_sessions_comment: Cross-device session sync via the hub's /sessions store (on api). device defaults to hostname; sync_keep = recent local sessions to push.
_mesh_comment: WireGuard mesh peers (the 4 VMs, per CLAUDE.md B.1). Consumed by the TUI status dashboard (CAS_MESH) for per-peer ICMP latency.
